concepts.label: fabric-attachment
concepts.gloss: A fabric-attachment that binds a specific local L2 domain (VLAN) to an access attachment point on a particular leaf switch, representing an access-port or leaf attachment in the fabric.
concepts.example: attach-leaf3-blue = an access attachment on leaf-3 that carries vlan-1201 (tenant-blue), i.e. the access-port binding that places that port into the tenant-blue VLAN.

concepts.label: fabric-vlan
concepts.gloss: A fabric-scoped L2 broadcast domain (a local/bridge VLAN) defined on a leaf switch to segregate tenant or service traffic at layer 2.
concepts.example: vlan-1201 (tenant-blue) = the local L2 domain configured on leaf-3 that carries all tenant-blue host traffic on that leaf.

concepts.label: leaf-switch
concepts.gloss: A leaf (ToR/access) switch node in the data‑center fabric that hosts access attachments and VLANs and uplinks into the fabric core (spines).
concepts.example: leaf-3 = a ToR/access switch that hosts attach-leaf3-blue and vlan-1201 (tenant-blue) and uplinks into the fabric spines (e.g., spine-1, spine-2).

concepts.label: fabric-mtu
concepts.gloss: An underlay framing parameter that records the maximum transmission unit (MTU) setting applied to a leaf (or its interfaces) and therefore to frames traversing that leaf.
concepts.example: MTU 9216 = the jumbo-frame MTU configured on leaf-3 so its uplinks and attached endpoints use 9216-byte frames across the fabric.

concepts.label: svi-gateway
concepts.gloss: A switched virtual interface (SVI) or VLAN gateway: the layer‑3 gateway IP/interface on a leaf that serves as the default router for hosts in a given VLAN.
concepts.example: svi-1201 (10.20.1.1) = the SVI configured on leaf-3 that provides the L3 gateway for hosts in vlan-1201 (tenant-blue).

concepts.label: spine-switch
concepts.gloss: A spine (fabric-core) switch node whose role is to interconnect leaf switches and carry inter-leaf and routed fabric traffic.
concepts.example: spine-1 = a fabric-core switch that uplinks to leaf-3 and leaf-4 to carry inter-leaf traffic and provide fabric forwarding.

concepts.label: availability-zone
concepts.gloss: An availability zone / fault-domain grouping that spans one or more leaf switches to represent a shared failure or locality domain within the fabric.
concepts.example: AZ-1 = an availability zone that contains leaf-3 (so leaf-3 is in the same fault domain AZ-1), while AZ-2 contains leaf-4.

concepts.label: lattice-tag-3
concepts.gloss: A vendor-proprietary, opaque per-leaf attribute (lattice-tag-3) used by the fabric for device-specific metadata or flags that are not part of the standard model.
concepts.example: lattice-tag-3=0x9 on leaf-3 = a vendor-specific tag value 0x9 attached to leaf-3 (used internally by the lattice fabric for proprietary behavior).
